lessons.keep: Make the selected source visible before showing the research output.
lessons.avoid: Using dense charts and source lists as visual proof without connecting a specific claim to its source.
lessons.open: Numerical accuracy, source coverage, plan availability, Spaces setup and audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, select customer feedback as a source, then show one resulting campaign insight with its source line.
Replace part of the report scroll with one chart value traced back to a filing passage.

comparison.story: Introduce the finance theme. → Specify the data source and analytical task. → Show an analytical output and source access. → Show a reusable research space for filing changes. → Close on the finance identity.
comparison.motion: Dollar-note layers undulate between title cards, prompt text builds, report pages scroll and the view reframes toward the heatmap and sources. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.
